Kara (Partnerships): Quick sync — need final checklist for demo day next Tue w/ Snowflake, Databricks, Qdrant + SI (Helix). Goal: live ingest -> vector search -> app call. Who owns runbook?
Matt (Eng): I can own infra steps. Need target cluster sizes and creds. Also: hardware partner (Lambda DGX box) for onprem demo? :thinking_face:
Sanjay (SolutionsEng): I'll handle connector wiring and SI handoff. Need sample dataset and schema. Can product provide README for mapping? @Oliver
Oliver (Product): Will add README + sample SQL mappings. Which Databricks runtime? beta-ml or stable?
Kara (Partnerships): Use stable runtime for demo. Helix SI will need a short ops doc. Leila — do we have one-pager for customers?
Leila (PMM): I'll prepare one-pager + launch blurb. Need one clear metric (latency @ 8k tokens?) Suggest 'avg query < 200ms for 512 vectors'.
Emily (Legal): NDA note — Helix asked for limited support access. We need to confirm data access window and retention. Can someone add clause to partner MSA?
Oliver (Product): I'll draft a short addendum. Emily, what's the minimum for legal?
Emily (Legal): 30-day access window, logs retained 90 days, no customer data export. I'll DM draft.
Matt (Eng): For infra — plan: 2x r5.large for ingest, 1x g5.4x for model runtime, qdrant on m5.large x2. Will that fit latency target? @Sanjay
Sanjay (SolutionsEng): Sounds fine. Need to enable prefix caching and KV cache set to 8GB. I'll test tomorrow.
ops-bot: deploy-check: demo infra env creation queued (job: 87421) — ETA 18m
Kara (Partnerships): Great. Timeline: infra test Mon, SI dry-run Tue morning, public joint blog Wed (internal OK). Leila will sync on assets Mon EOD.
Leila (PMM): Setting up draft assets in /assets/marketplace/demo-day. Will share link when ready.
Matt (Eng): Quick command for connector deploy (for ops):
```bash
redwood deploy connector --provider snowflake --target databricks --schema demo_v1
```
Sanjay (SolutionsEng): Also we need to pin model to v1.2-quant for consistent perf.
Kara (Partnerships): Action items: Matt infra, Sanjay connectors + SI runbook, Oliver README + addendum, Leila assets + comms, Emily legal addendum. Check-ins Mon 11am PT. :rocket:
Oliver (Product): noted.
